name: Jiwon Yoon
source:
“I’m so excited because of you!”

He's the type of person who always gives his all– the model student type, like a class vice president. 
When I see him quietly wrestle with what it truly means to be a doctor, it's clear... there is a story behind his resolve. 
But when he smiles so brightly, I hesitate. 
I'm afraid to disturb something so carefully hidden. 
They say every wound leaves a scar... 
But no... maybe not this time.
